title: Learning to use local AI is exciting, overwhelming, and frustrating
slides: Local AI promises freedom, but why does it feel so hard?
Setup takes hours before you write a single prompt
The hardest part isn't code—it's unlearning cloud habits
You can run models offline with just a laptop
Pick one tool today and break it deliberately
thread_text:
1. The Setup Trap

A 20-minute task became a 6-hour odyssey. Local AI promises freedom, but you pay in time before you ever type a prompt.

2. Cloud vs Local

The hardest part isn't code. It's unlearning the habit of someone else's server handling your data. Offline means you own the weight.

3. Laptop Freedom

No internet, no subscription, no surveillance. Just a laptop and a model running in your room. This is the promise finally delivered.

4. Break One Tool

Don't optimize. Pick a single local model today and deliberately break it. The fastest way to learn limits is to exceed them.

5. Test Your Patience

If setup takes hours, does the freedom justify the cost? Try one offline prompt this week. If you haven't, you haven't felt the trade-off.
